entries.title: A task board tile's summary stays open until you move on
entries.body: When the arrows reach a tile on the task board, its summary no longer closes by itself a moment after it opens on a busy Mac. Esc then closes the summary first, and the next Esc clears Find.
entries.noPicture: The summary looks as it did; it now stays open where it used to close by itself a moment after opening.

entries.title: The task board keeps the keyboard when you come back to the window
entries.body: On a busy Mac, coming back to Infinitary while the task board was open could leave the arrows moving nothing until you clicked a tile. The tile that had the keyboard now keeps it.
entries.noPicture: The board looks as it did; the keyboard now stays on its tile when the window comes forward.
